question: Can any sacred place equal the sanctity of the Yamunā?
premises: Sacred places may be compared in sanctity
The Yamunā is presented as a standard of comparison
No equal to the Yamunā's sacred place exists
inference: No sacred place is equal to that of the Yamunā, without doubt
plain_english: There is no sacred place equal to that of the Yamunā; there is no doubt.
